---
title: "Species Overview"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("setup.R")

make_boxplot <- function(data, yvar, yname) {
  # Compute boxplot stats manually per species
  species_list <- c("Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo")
  box_data <- lapply(species_list, function(sp) {
    vals <- data[[yvar]][data$species == sp]
    vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
    qs <- as.numeric(quantile(vals, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)))
    qs
  })

  e_charts(init = NULL) |>
    e_list(list(
      xAxis = list(
        type = "category",
        data = species_list,
        name = "Species"
      ),
      yAxis = list(
        type = "value",
        name = yname
      ),
      series = list(list(
        type = "boxplot",
        data = box_data,
        itemStyle = list(
          color = "transparent",
          borderColor = "#ff6b35"
        )
      )),
      tooltip = list(trigger = "item"),
      toolbox = list(feature = list(saveAsImage = list()))
    ))
}
```

Explore body measurements across the three penguin species.

## Bill Length

<div style="max-width: 500px;">
```{r}
make_boxplot(penguins_clean, "bill_length_mm", "Bill Length (mm)")
```
</div>
